statement: A single shared component that many workers route through can cause many workers to fail or drift simultaneously, even when each individual worker appears healthy in isolation.
original: If that one harness breaks or drifts, 60 workers go wrong at once. That is a blast-radius risk, and it is exactly the kind of thing I rely on you to surface, because it is invisible when you look one worker at a time.

statement: Concentration of workers on a shared dependency is a structural risk, not a current incident; a fleet where most workers share one dependency is one change away from a fleet-wide problem.
original: concentration is a structural risk, not a current incident. A fleet where most workers share one dependency is one change away from a fleet-wide problem
